text.jp:
ダグザ暦１４４９年１２月下旬――
半年以上にわたり数々の名勝負が繰り広げられた
祭典は幕を閉じ、かつての熱狂が薄らぎつつある
ダグシオンに、その報は突然もたらされた。
text.official_en:
Dagdan Imperial Calendar, year 1449, Decim.
A shocking turn of events marked the end of a year
already historic for its Heroic Games. Dagsion was
quieting after months of battle when came the news.

text.jp:
実に５００年もの長きにわたって眠りについていた
神威大帝ダグザが目覚め、ダグザ帝国の支配者の
玉座に返り咲いたというのである。
text.official_en:
Dagda the Great had woken from his long slumber
and retaken his throne after a five-hundred-year
absence. He ruled the Dagdan Empire once more.

text.jp:
本来であれば帝国にとってこの上なくめでたい
出来事にもかかわらず、祝いの儀式の一切も
行われないままに、時間だけが過ぎてゆく。
text.official_en:
It should have been a joyous occasion, but not one
festival or celebration was held, not that day or in the
weeks that followed. A strange waking, indeed.

text.jp:
神殿がこぞって奇妙な沈黙を続ける中で、
ダグシオンの街は只ならぬ緊張感に包まれたまま
新しい年を迎えるのだった。
text.official_en:
The temples went eerily silent, which added to the
sense of deep unease. As Dagsion entered a new
year, tension spread to all reaches of the city.

text.jp:
市民たちは互いの顔を見合わせ、様々な憶測を
口にしつつ、やがて神殿が見せるであろう、
次の動きを不安げな様子で待つばかりであった。
text.official_en:
People exchanged wary glances in the streets. They
speculated. They shared apprehensions. And most
of all, they waited—for any word from the temples.

text.jp:
――聖キッホル著「ダグザ戦乱史」　
第１部　序章より
text.official_en:
—Saint Cichol, "History of the Dagdan War,"
Part 1, Prologue

text.jp: ダグザ暦１４５０年初頭――
text.official_en: Dagdan Imperial Calendar, year 1450.

text.jp:
神威大帝ダグザは「大ダグザ宣言」を発布。
それは、新年を迎えたばかりの
帝国全土に激震をもたらすこととなる。
text.official_en:
Divine Emperor Dagda made his authority known in
the new year with a statement that thundered across
the empire: the Supreme Dagdan Declaration.

text.jp:
神威大帝はこの中で、自分こそが
ダグザの地を支配する唯一にして絶対の
存在であることを改めて強調し、
text.official_en:
This far-reaching declaration reasserted that he,
and he alone, had absolute control over the land
as Divine Emperor.

text.jp:
併せて、神威法王ソレルが重大な背信行為を
理由に神威大帝の手で直々に処断されたという
衝撃的な事実も公表されたのだった。
text.official_en:
Dagda revealed that Divine Sovereign Solel had
committed high crimes of treason, and for that he
had executed Solel by his own hand.
text.real_en:
Dagda revealed that Divine Sovereign Sorell had
committed high crimes of treason, and for that he
had executed Sorell by his own hand.

text.jp:
さらに、ダグザ帝国の南部地域に領土を構える
サラミス王国について、「大帝の意に反する
不法な占拠である」と断じ、宣戦を布告。
text.official_en:
The statement was also a war declaration, asserting
that Saramis was an unlawful occupation in the
south, established contrary to his imperial will.

text.jp:
また、ダグシオン大闘技場の即時解体という
不可解な決定も宣告され、市民から多くが
この作業に投入される事となった。
text.official_en:
The final part of this supreme proclamation held a
baffling command—to demolish the Dagsion arena.
Many citizens were put to work on this at once.

text.jp:

重大な決断の刻が迫っていたのであった。
text.official_en:
As dread gripped the empire, Queen Theodora rose
to confront the growing challenge to her nation. She
had a decision to make—about the future of Saramis.

text.official_en:
—Saint Cichol, "History of the Dagdan War,"
